splitHalf.method: Descriptive odd/even match_id split; same score formulas, lower per-half eligibility thresholds. Not a chronological holdout.
splitHalf.interpretation: Low split-half agreement means rank order is sensitive to match sample. Treat ranks as exploratory, not definitive.

notes: IPL-only competitions selected by comp_name == IPL YYYY
No economy or chase required-rate reconstruction
